instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the word. <break time='500ms'/> Push.

feedback.end: To push means to move something away from you.

instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the word. <break time='500ms'/> Pull.

feedback.end: To pull means to move something towards you.

instruction.text: Is the thing in the picture being pushed or pulled?

feedback.end: The woman is pulling the suitcase behind her as she walks.
The person is pushing the giant rock and trying to move it forwards.
The person in the picture is pulling carrots out of the ground.
The person in the picture is pushing the button.
The man in the picture is pushing the pushchair forwards.
The children in the picture are pulling on the rope.
The biker is pushing the bicycle up the hill because it is too steep to ride it.
